1445-4871-7396-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7396-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1531-4279-4314--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-4314--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4050-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3318-3585.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-3585.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

631-728-6249--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Grim Haruspex trigger.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

728-2281-3305.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-5933.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-7918.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-7918.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2946-4871-4976-5147.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-4976-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4030-5078-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4030-5078-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Medusa triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

698-3923-4050-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-3923-4050-7639.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Mystic Speculation by paying {U} due to Will.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Mystic Speculation.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

813-4377-7431.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Daydream from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

757-2930-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3257-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3257-4231-4772.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4460-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
4460-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4460-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

465-2150-5231.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-2744-5147-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-5147-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-5147-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

643-1669-2366-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
643-1669-2366-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1308-1358-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1315-1479-6754.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-6754.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Eusocial Engineering and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

539-4050-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

864-2091-6785.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten tapped lands.
864-2091-6785.description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying {3}{R}{R}, adding {R} for each tapped land your opponents control.
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {4}{R}, creating two token copies of Eternal Witness with haste.
When the Eternal Witness tokens enter, they trigger, returning Mana Geyser and Devastating Onslaught from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1414-2854-4574-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1414-2854-4574-5741.description:
Cast Lotus Petal either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2-560-2034-5554.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a 1/1 Gnome artifact creature token.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Gnome and Soldier, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

3391-4871-6019-6798.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1537-3817-4050-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-4068-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1256-1270-4068-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

413-708-2459-4948.notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Myth Unbound.
413-708-2459-4948.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1274-2060-2625-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Kibo.
1274-2060-2625-3525.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Activate the Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

2498-4691-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2498-4691-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Sheoldred's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

357-1528-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Dual Casting and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature.
The creature with Dual Casting attached does not have summoning sickness.
357-1528-2178-4050.description:
Cast Force of Rage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Force of Rage.
Resolve the copy of Force of Rage, creating two  3/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {R}.
The Elemental dies, triggering the creature with Thornbite Staff attached, untapping the creature.
Repeat from step 2 for an arbitrarily large number of creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elementals, adding {2}.
Thornbite Staff triggers twice, untapping the equipped creature.
Activate the equipped creature by paying {2} and tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 7.

2034-2744-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2744-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
The Triskelavite enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Triskelavite tokens, you may sacrifice them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1766-3094-4404-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Corridor Monitor does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
1766-3094-4404-4711.description:
Declare Corridor Monitor as an attacker, triggering its myriad ability.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger.
Resolve the copy of Corridor Monitor's myriad trigger, creating a token copy of Corridor Monitor that is tapped and attacking each other opponent.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Thran Dynamo and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

1047-3750-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Mobile Garrison is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
Your devotion to red is at least five.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Mobile Garrison.
1047-3750-4306.description:
Declare Mobile Garrison as an attacker.
Mobile Garrison triggers, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2269-3426-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deranged Hermit, adding {G}.
Deranged Hermit dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Deranged Hermit on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Deranged Hermit from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrel tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.

1407-2584-2615.description:
Activate Dollhouse of Horrors by paying {1}, tapping it and exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard, creating a token copy of Tree of Perdition that is a 0/0 Construct with haste.
The Tree of Perdition copy enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition copy by tapping it, exchanging its toughness with target opponent's life total.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, causing the Tree of Perdition token to deal damage equal to its power to each opponent.
The opponent whose life total was swapped loses the game due to having zero or les life.

2493-3617-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
2493-3617-3742.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer that is tapped and attacking.
Archaeomancer enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
